title: Code and data for: Cell-mediated immune regulation may have evolved before adaptive immunity in jawed vertebrates: a modeling study
description: The ODE model, the parameter sweep and selection pipeline, the gated set of simulations, and one script per figure of the paper. See README.md for how to reproduce every figure from the shipped data.
